# ReadFloat

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Streams](BlitzBasic-Streams)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
ReadFloat:Float32 stream:Int32
```

## Description

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

_Not documented yet._

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stream` | Int32 | required | The stream to read from. |

**Returns:** The next 4 bytes of the stream as a float.
